'''Catherine Jeandel''' is a French geochemical oceanographer known for her research on [[isotope geochemistry]] and trace elements in the ocean.

== Education and career ==
Jeandel grew up in northern [[Brittany]] wanting to be an ocean scientist, despite a lack of interest in mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Catherine Jeandel {{!}} CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/en/person/catherine-jeandel|access-date=2021-09-12|website=www.cnrs.fr|language=en}}</ref> She was a student at the [[École normale supérieure de jeunes filles|École normale supérieure de Sèvres]] from 1977 to 1982.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Catherine Jeandel élue à la présidence du Conseil Académique de l'Université Fédérale {{!}} Université de Toulouse|url=https://www.univ-toulouse.fr/actualites/catherine-jeandel-elue-presidence-du-conseil-academique-de-universite-federale|access-date=2021-09-12|website=www.univ-toulouse.fr}}</ref> Jeandel earned a B.S. and her Ph.D. at the [[University of Paris VII]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=December 2014|title=Meet your 2014 Board of Directors|url=http://elementsmagazine.org/archives/e10_6/e10_6_sn_geochemsoc.pdf|url-status=live|access-date=September 11, 2021|website=Elements|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150630131143/http://www.elementsmagazine.org/archives/e10_6/e10_6_sn_geochemsoc.pdf |archive-date=2015-06-30 }}</ref>

From 1982 until 1983, she was a research associate at the [[Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris]].<ref name=":1" /> She joined the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|Centre national de la recherche scientifique]] (CNRS) in 1983. From 1988 until 1990, Jeandel was at the [[Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory|Lamont-Doherty Geological Observatory]]. She was promoted to research director at the CNRS in 2007.<ref name=":1" />

In 2018, Jeandel was elected a fellow of the [[American Geophysical Union]] who cited her "for fundamental research on the marine [[biogeochemical cycle]]s of trace elements and for exploiting them as tracers in chemical and paleoceanography".<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Jeandel|url=https://honors.agu.org/honorsfellow/jeandel/|access-date=2021-09-11|website=Honors Program|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Research ==
Jeandel is known for her research on trace elements found in seawater and on marine particles, include investigations into [[vanadium]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Jeandel|first1=C|last2=Caisso|first2=M|last3=Minster|first3=J.F|date=1987|title=Vanadium behaviour in the global ocean and in the Mediterranean sea|url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/0304420387900296|journal=Marine Chemistry|language=en|volume=21|issue=1|pages=51–74|doi=10.1016/0304-4203(87)90029-6|bibcode=1987MarCh..21...51J|url-access=subscription}}</ref> [[chromium]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Jeandel|first1=C|last2=Minster|first2=J.-F|date=1984|title=Isotope dilution measurement of inorganic chromium(III) and total chromium in seawater|url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/0304420384900306|journal=Marine Chemistry|language=en|volume=14|issue=4|pages=347–364|doi=10.1016/0304-4203(84)90030-6|bibcode=1984MarCh..14..347J|url-access=subscription}}</ref> and [[neodymium]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Jeandel|first=C.|date=1993|title=Concentration and isotopic composition of Nd in the South Atlantic Ocean|journal=Earth and Planetary Science Letters|language=en|volume=117|issue=3–4|pages=581–591|doi=10.1016/0012-821X(93)90104-H|bibcode=1993E&PSL.117..581J |doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Jeandel|first1=C.|last2=Bishop|first2=J.K.|last3=Zindler|first3=A.|date=1995|title=Exchange of neodymium and its isotopes between seawater and small and large particles in the Sargasso Sea|journal=Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta|language=en|volume=59|issue=3|pages=535–547|doi=10.1016/0016-7037(94)00367-U|bibcode=1995GeCoA..59..535J |doi-access=free}}</ref> She has examined trace elements at multiple locations in the global ocean, include time-series sites such as KERFIX, in the [[Southern Ocean]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Jeandel|first1=Catherine|last2=Ruiz-Pino|first2=Diana|last3=Gjata|first3=Elvis|last4=Poisson|first4=Alain|last5=Brunet|first5=Christian|last6=Charriaud|first6=Edwige|last7=Dehairs|first7=Frank|last8=Delille|first8=Daniel|last9=Fiala|first9=Michel|last10=Fravalo|first10=Charles|last11=Carlos
